opening.argument: The presentation ties rewards to purchased pools, binary cycles, and the growth of a recruited structure. It says that a personally invited participant's first share purchase produces “five percent from the first purchase of any share,” while another slide assigns percentage bonuses across personally invited users and those beneath them. The recurring benefit is also expressly linked to recruitment: after “you've recruited nine or more people on your active team that purchased at least 1 pool,” the speaker says, “you start to get many counts all day long.” That structure makes participation and downstream team purchases central to the promised rewards, and the closing direction to “bitclub.plus” turns the explanation into an invitation to connect with the company.
